summary: Curanex Pharmaceuticals Inc filed an 8-K reporting that it regained compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) after its closing bid price stayed at or above $1.00 for ten consecutive business days from August 20 to September 2, 2026, following a 1-for-20 reverse stock split effected on August 20, 2026. This is a routine regulatory compliance update, not a special-situation event. No strategic transaction, activist campaign, or other corporate action is involved. The Nasdaq matter is now closed. What to watch: further compliance with ongoing listing standards and potential volatility post-split.
